text.lead: Bukowski: Born Into This is a 2003 American documentary film about American author Charles Bukowski.
text.reception: On review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, the film holds an approval rating of 85% based on 50 reviews, with an average rating of 7.3/10. The website's consensus reads: "A thoroughly engrossing documentary examining the life of talented but troubled writer Charles Bukowski." On Metacritic, the film holds a rating of 77 out of 100, based on 25 critics, indicating "generally favorable reviews".
